script.title: Agreement vs Contract
script.caption_hook: Every contract is an agreement, but not every agreement is a contract!

lines.say: Ma'am, is every agreement a contract? Or are they the same thing?
Not quite. Every contract is an agreement, but not every agreement is a contract.
Wait, then what exactly is an agreement?
A proposal, once accepted, becomes a promise. Promises forming consideration for each other are an agreement, Section 2(e).
Section 2(h): an agreement enforceable by law is a contract.

board.title: Contract Sec 2(h)
board.sub: Enforceable by law makes it a contract

lines.say: So can an agreement exist without being enforceable?
Yes! A promise to attend a friend's dinner is one. Nobody intends legal consequences, so courts won't enforce it.
Okay, and a sale of goods for a price?
Sale is a contract. It needs legal intention, free consent, competent parties, lawful consideration and object, and must not be declared void.
So a contract sits inside agreement, like a small circle in a big one!
Exactly! Everything in the small circle is also in the big one, never the reverse.
So all contracts are agreements, but not all agreements are contracts?
Yes. Remember: agreement is big, contract is core.
